title.en: The baby keeps moving. Can the MRI learn to follow?
title.zh: 胎儿不停动，磁共振能否跟着拍？

summary.en: E(3)-Pose builds head symmetry into motion estimation. Better fetal imaging is the promise; improved clinical diagnoses and fewer repeat visits remain unproven here.
summary.zh: E(3)-Pose把头部对称性嵌入姿态估计；成像或可改善，但诊断提升及减少复诊尚未在此证实。

title.en: Anthropic pledges5%of its shares. Who decides the public benefit?
title.zh: Anthropic拟拨5%股份做公益，谁来定义公众利益？

summary.en: A proposed wholly-owned LLC could grow its stake at board discretion. Equity commitments, cash distributions and independent governance are different claims.
summary.zh: 拟设全资LLC，董事会可酌情增拨；股份承诺、现金派发与独立治理是三回事。
